subject: Stage-gate MAP & commercial bridge for Acme Corp — on-prem evaluation & platform fee
body:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@acmecorp.com>, Tom Richardson <tom.richardson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage-gate MAP & commercial bridge for Acme Corp — on-prem evaluation & platform fee

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — I captured the core runbook we discussed and attached a first-pass MAP (Acme-MAP-v1.pdf). High level: we propose a 6-week stage-gate evaluation that transitions into a time-phased commercial commit tied to acceptance milestones so both sides have clear outcomes and pricing triggers.

Proposed MAP (summary):
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment access (Redwood private control plane in your VPC; legal LOE for access)
- Weeks 1–2: Functional POC (API integration, latency tests, sample queries) — acceptance criteria A1/A2
- Weeks 3–4: Scale tests (throughput, caching behavior, KV load) — acceptance criteria B1
- Week 5: Security/compliance review (SOC2 artifacts, network diagram, KMS plan) — acceptance criteria C1
- Week 6: Evaluation review & go/no-go decision; commercial close if go

Commercial bridge (what we outlined on the call):
- Pilot pricing: reduced platform fee for the evaluation period — $5k/month, refundable against first 12 months if you convert
- Conversion commit: tiered commit with ramp: Month 1 commit = 50k tokens/day equivalent (baseline) -> Month 6 = scale to committed throughput (see SOW appendix)
- Platform fee: $25k/month baseline for private/VPC (includes control plane, monitoring, 30-day log retention). We can reduce to $18k/month after a 12-month committed ramp to >= 3x baseline throughput.
- Discounts: 10% off list for a 12-month prepay; 18% for a 24-month prepay. Additional volume-based discounting tied to token commit bands (see MAP table).

Action items for Acme:
1) Confirm target acceptance criteria for functional POC (deadline Thu 3/25)
2) Provide network CIDR and point-of-contact for infra onboarding (deadline Mon 3/29)
3) Share any mandatory contract clauses (data residency, IP carve-outs, audit) for initial redline (legal contact: Natalie)

I’ll follow up with Marissa and Karthik to align commercial language in the SOW and to prepare a DocuSign route once we have sign-off on the MAP skeleton.

Best,
Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0168

Attachment stubs: Acme-MAP-v1.pdf (11 pages)

-----Original Message-----
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@acmecorp.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Richardson <tom.richardson@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP & commercial bridge for Acme Corp — on-prem evaluation & platform fee

Diego —

Thanks for the summary. Tom and I reviewed and a couple quick clarifying Qs: 1) for the refundable pilot fee — is that a dollar-for-dollar credit or does it apply only to the platform fee portion? 2) for the SOC2 artifacts, we’ll need a list of specific evidence items so our security team can triage (e.g., encryption-in-transit certs, key rotation logs).

We also want to confirm that the private deployment includes an option to run in our isolated subnet with our own KMS — that was core to our legal team.

— Samantha

-----Reply Message-----
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP & commercial bridge for Acme Corp — on-prem evaluation & platform fee

Great Qs — quick answers inline: 
1) Refundable pilot fee: it’s dollar-for-dollar and applies to the platform fee portion only; we will credit the pilot fee against the first 12 months of platform fees on conversion (we can also apportion to committed credits if you prefer).
2) SOC2 evidence list: attached (SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx). We’ll include the standard set your security team typically asks for (network diagrams, encryption-in-transit, KMS architecture, logging & retention statements, SOC2 report redacted).
3) KMS: yes — we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key). We’ll document the handshake and key access model in the SOW appendix.

On the platform fee and discounts: Marissa, Karthik — can you confirm the reduced evaluation fee language and the conditional discounting tied to ramp? I want to make sure the crediting workflow is clear in the SOW: pilot_fee_credit -> applied to M1-M12 platform fees, then prepay discounts stack on top of the residual invoice.

Thanks,
Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive

Attachment stubs: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (1 sheet)

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP & commercial bridge for Acme Corp — on-prem evaluation & platform fee

Diego —

Draft commercial language below for the SOW: 
- Pilot fee: $5,000 payable on kickoff; refundable and applied as a credit to platform fees billed in Months 1–12 upon contract execution.
- Platform fee: Monthly platform fee for Private/VPC deployments is $25,000 unless the customer executes a 12 or 24 month prepay which reduces the fee as specified in Appendix B.
- Ramp credits: If customer achieves the ramp milestones in Sections 2.2–2.4, Redwood will issue a one-time ramp credit equal to 5% of monthly platform fee for the month of conversion.

I’ll add the exact HubSpot deal link and SOW id when ready. Also recommend we include an explicit acceptance test matrix in the MAP to avoid scope drift — call out sample queries, latency p95 thresholds, and KV cache hit rate.

Marissa

-----Forwarded Message-----
From: Natalie Price <natalie@acmecorplegal.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Richardson <tom.richardson@acmecorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP & commercial bridge for Acme Corp — on-prem evaluation & platform fee

Diego / Marissa —

Legal has a few redlines we need to get ahead of before bringing this to purchasing. Key asks: data residency clause to ensure customer data remains in US-based regions; limitation of liability cap aligned to fees; breach notification SLA (48 hours). Also request a diagram of the control plane separation and confirmation that Redwood will not have access to customer plaintext keys.

Please let me know if you can provide a revised SOW with these items and we’ll circle back.

Thanks,
Natalie

-----Reply Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@acmecorp.com>, Tom Richardson <tom.richardson@acmecorp.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP & commercial bridge for Acme Corp — on-prem evaluation & platform fee

Hi all —

We’ve updated the SOW draft to incorporate the legal asks and clarified the crediting mechanics. Next steps I propose:
- Thu 4/7: Technical kickoff (Redwood infra + Acme infra POCs)
- Fri 4/9: SOW redline returned for final legal review
- Fri 4/16: Execute pilot payment and start Week 1 POC

Two commercial clarifications for Acme: 1) to qualify for the 18% 24-month prepay discount the prepay must be received within 60 days of SOW execution; 2) ramp credits are one-time and apply only at conversion (not retroactive).

If that timeline looks good I’ll create the DocuSign envelope and the HubSpot milestone checklist.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
